description: Search federal funding opportunities on Grants.gov by keyword, agency, applicant eligibility, funding category, funding instrument, assistance listing, opportunity number, posting window (posted_within_days), or closing window (closing_within_days). Returns forecasted and posted opportunities unless statuses says otherwise, each row led by its close date and days remaining, plus facet counts for narrowing. Bare keyword terms are all required; join alternatives with OR, in parentheses when other terms stay required. Rows carry no award amounts or eligibility detail; read those with grantsgov_get_opportunity. Filter codes come from grantsgov_list_reference.

agencies.description: Agency codes from grantsgov_list_reference topic agencies (e.g. HHS, HHS-NIH11, NSF). One whole string or an array, up to 10 nonblank entries. A code includes its sub-agencies. Case-insensitive. Any listed agency matches.

assistance_listing.description: One assistance listing number (ALN, formerly CFDA), e.g. 93.866 or 93866, in any case. Only one value is supported.

closing_within_days.description: Only posted opportunities closing between today and N days from today, US Eastern (0-365; 0 = closing today). Searches posted opportunities in close-date order, so statuses may only be posted and sort only close_date_asc.

eligibilities.description: Two-digit applicant-type codes from grantsgov_list_reference topic eligibilities (e.g. 12 = nonprofits with 501(c)(3) status, 07 = federally recognized tribal governments). One whole string or an array of strings or numbers, up to 17 nonblank entries. A single digit is zero-padded (7 = 07). Any listed type matches.

funding_categories.description: Funding category codes from grantsgov_list_reference topic funding_categories (e.g. HL = Health, ED = Education). One whole string or an array, up to 28 nonblank entries. Case-insensitive. Any listed category matches.

funding_instruments.description: Funding instruments: G (grant), CA (cooperative agreement), PC (procurement contract), O (other). One whole string or an array, up to 4 nonblank entries. Any listed instrument matches.

include_facets.description: Include facet counts per filter value. Set false when paging to save space.

include_unrestricted.description: When eligibilities is set, also match opportunities open to any applicant type (code 99), which the specific codes do not cover. Set false to see only opportunities targeted at the listed types.

keyword.description: Full-text search over title, description, opportunity number, and agency. Bare terms are all required (rural broadband = rural AND broadband); join alternatives with OR, quote phrases ("mental health"), exclude with NOT or -term, and use a trailing * for prefixes (broad*). OR mixed with AND or with bare terms must be grouped in parentheses, e.g. (rural OR tribal) broadband; an ungrouped mix is rejected. A word with an internal hyphen or period (COVID-19, K-12) is matched as a phrase. Field prefixes (agency:NSF, cfda:93.866) are rejected: use the agencies, assistance_listing, or other filter instead. See grantsgov_list_reference topic keyword_syntax.

limit.description: Requested rows per page (1-1,000; default 25). Values above 100 return 100 rows with a notice.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset for paging; use next_offset from the previous page.

opportunity_number.description: Exact agency-assigned opportunity number (e.g. HRSA-27-005), matched case-insensitively; one pair of surrounding double quotes is removed. Numbers are not unique across agencies, so several rows can match. To look up a number across every status, prefer grantsgov_get_opportunity with opportunity_numbers.

posted_within_days.description: Only opportunities posted in the last N days (1-3650). Works only with the forecasted and posted statuses.

sort.description: Result order: relevance (best keyword match; needs keyword, otherwise the order is arbitrary), open_date_desc/open_date_asc (posting date), close_date_asc/close_date_desc (close date; no close date sorts last on asc), opportunity_number_asc/_desc, agency_asc/_desc. Default: relevance with a keyword, else open_date_desc.

statuses.description: Lifecycle statuses to include: forecasted, posted, closed, archived. One whole string or an array, up to 4 nonblank entries. Default: forecasted and posted.

name: grantsgov_search_opportunities

applied_filters.description: Filters as the server applied them, including defaults and expansions.

agencies_sent.description: Agency filter as sent upstream: pipe-joined, with sub-agency subtrees expanded and codes containing spaces quoted.

closing_cutoff_date.description: Last close date inside the closing window, YYYY-MM-DD (US Eastern).

eligibilities_sent.description: Applicant-type codes as sent upstream, pipe-joined, including 99 when include_unrestricted added it.

include_unrestricted.description: The include_unrestricted setting; it acts only when eligibilities is set.

statuses_defaulted.description: True when statuses was not given and the default (forecasted, posted) applied.

effective_keyword.description: The keyword as compiled and sent upstream.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_keyword`: The keyword has unbalanced quotes or parentheses, a leading AND/OR, a trailing or doubled operator, or nothing left after removing unsupported characters. `unknown_agency`: An agencies code is neither a known agency code nor a hyphen-delimited prefix of one. `unknown_eligibility`: An eligibilities code is not in the applicant-type list. `unknown_funding_category`: A funding_categories code is not in the category list. `filter_conflict`: posted_within_days with closed or archived in statuses; closing_within_days with statuses other than posted or a sort other than close_date_asc. `upstream_unavailable`: Grants.gov did not respond, or returned a 5xx, a non-JSON body, a non-zero errorcode, or a backend-unavailable message, after retries. `rate_limited`: Grants.gov answered HTTP 429 (rate limited) through every retry, or asked for a wait longer than the retry budget. `upstream_route_unavailable`: Grants.gov answered HTTP 403 Missing Authentication Token: the search route no longer exists at the gateway. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facets.description: Counts per filter value for the current filters. Omitted when include_facets is false.

items.description: One facet value with its count.

sub_agencies.description: Current-query subtree counts per sub-agency, including known intermediate parents. Present only when agencies is set. Number mode retains upstream facet scope; closing-window facets cover the wider posted set.

next_offset.description: Offset for the next page; absent on the last page.

notice.description: Zero-hit or window guidance naming the next call.

agency_code.description: Owning agency code, e.g. HHS-HRSA. Omitted when the record lists none.

agency_name.description: Owning agency name. Omitted when the record lists none.

assistance_listings.description: Assistance listing numbers (ALN, formerly CFDA). Empty when none listed.

close_date.description: Close date as listed, YYYY-MM-DD. Omitted when none is listed.

close_date_kind.description: fixed = a real deadline; none_listed = no close date in search (rolling or open-ended, and every forecast: its estimated close date is on the grantsgov_get_opportunity record); placeholder = a far-future stand-in date the agency uses for "accepted anytime".

days_until_close.description: Days from today (US Eastern) to close_date. Present only when close_date_kind is fixed; 0 = closes today; negative for a posted record whose close date passed before Grants.gov updated its status.

doc_type.description: Whether the record is a posted synopsis or a forecast.

open_date.description: Posting date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omitted when not listed.

opportunity_id.description: Numeric Grants.gov id as a digit string. Pass to grantsgov_get_opportunity.opportunity_ids.

totalCount.description: Total matching opportunities (the closing-window count in closing_within_days mode).

truncated.description: True when more rows exist past this page.
